scope: One fixed observed-curve feature experiment; no runtime or release change
architecture: Append48 descriptors (12per expert) to existing548 observed inputs; same32 tanh hidden units/four softmax position weights, frozen v20 rotations and parent expert. Use v21 original equal-cohort loss and40epochs, not the failed v22 relative loss.
features: At nine fixed normalized query times, summarize each expert versus linear using mean/max positional excursion, speed, acceleration, incoming/outgoing tangent mismatch and semantic-edge length deviation. Normalize by observed per-joint position amplitude or rest semantic-edge length, map zero denominators to zero, apply log1p. Descriptors are not physical guarantees or calibrated uncertainty probabilities.
training: Calculate any parent-dependent descriptors with the exact group-excluded parent used for that row. No target or hidden-frame data enters descriptors. No new parent fits or input observations.
verification: Before fitting: feature shape/finite/scaling/masked/zero-motion/label-independence checks, explicit loss and finite differences, actual supervised fitting, priority and serialization checks. Freeze before development, repeat exactly, actual-rig editable/recovery tests.
gates: Unchanged old/new/combined gates; every original control retained; six fresh confirmation clips sealed unless all gates pass.
